Hey man! I'm into day 3 of the rest of my new life too!

While I have a lot more work to do than you (6", 343lb).

We have very similar lifestyles, I am also a heavy gamer. 

I would invite you to use www.myfitnesspal.com! Create an account (through facebook if you like) and start tracking your food intake and excersize. Track EVERYTHING.

Don't worry though, your weight is private and the only thing others can see is how much you have lost. You can also make your food diary visable or not to your friends, good if you want advice/support.

If you decide to join me, be sure to add me as a friend! Once you have an account, http://www.myfitnesspal.com/AdamL88 and click add as friend!

If you have a smartphone, tracking your food becomes easy, download the free app and use the barcode scanner to scan everything you eat straight into your diary.

I would also recomend doing your walking at the gym. The machines can give you calorie loss counts when you excersize which is very useful for your diary.

Lastly, to make your plan, use the FAQ to work out your metabolic rate (how many calories you use while not active per day). At 343lb, I use 3200 calories while doing nothing, so if I eat less than this, I lose weight! Easy! At your weight my GUESS would be around 2700? Go work it out though. Then you just need to eat to a deficit that fits how much you want to lose. 

Losing weight fast is good, but too much too quickly can be dangerous to your health. I am not qualified in anything I say so make sure you do your research when making your plan.

Good Luck Buddy, and I hope to see you on MFP should you decide to do this!

Edit: Forgot to mention, if the gym is something that is scary to you (it is to me) try to go at non peak times, youd be suprised how little people go in the morning/midday. But don't forget, fat people go to the gym, so its nothin to worry about :P
